title: Hver synes best om sine barn
world: A forest in old Norway, long ago, where the birds can talk. A narrow footpath winds through a light forest of pine, spruce and birch and along the edge of a wide, open bog with white tufts of cotton grass, soft moss, heather, cloudberry plants and small dark pools. The dunlin's four chicks hide in a grassy tussock beside the path, a little way from where she first meets the hunter. The hunter is a kind man out for a stroll: he carries only his walking stick and a leather game bag. The dunlin and her chicks are natural birds.
palette: A still July midday at the bog: warm sunshine with soft dappled shade under the pines, fluffy white tufts of cotton grass, ripening orange cloudberries, rusty-red and olive-green bog moss, dark pools reflecting a hazy pale sky, and a few blue dragonflies.

cast.name: Jegeren
cast.description: En snill jeger som finner noen rufsete fugleunger i gresset og vil ta dem med hjem, fordi han tror de ikke har noen mor.
cast.look: A sturdy, cheerful hunter of about thirty-five with a round, sunburnt face, a snub nose, merry green eyes, straight dark-brown hair and a thick dark-brown beard that splits into two little forks at the chin. He wears a small green felt hat with a curled brim and one bright-blue jay feather, an olive-brown wool jacket with big patch pockets, brown leather knee breeches, red knitted socks and lace-up boots, with a leather game bag across his chest, and carries only a crooked hazel walking stick.
cast.portrait: Background: the Bog Path through the sunny forest.

cast.name: Myrsnipen
cast.description: En liten fuglemor som ber jegeren la barna hennes være, for hun synes de er de vakreste i hele skogen.
cast.look: A small, round-bodied dunlin in summer plumage, about the size of a starling, with a rusty-chestnut back speckled with black, a pale head and breast finely streaked with grey, a big black patch on her white belly, a long, slightly down-curved black beak, thin black legs and bright black eyes. When she spreads her wings, a white stripe shows along each one. A brave, proud little mother.
cast.portrait: Background: white cotton grass on the bog.

cast.name: Myrsnipungene
cast.description: Små, rufsete fugleunger med dun som stritter til alle kanter, og som ikke sier annet enn «pip».
cast.look: Four tiny dunlin chicks, all alike, each a round ball of fluffy down no bigger than a plum. Their scruffy down sticks out in all directions: golden-brown and black mottled on top, sprinkled with tiny white dots like powder, and pale grey underneath. They have short, straight black beaks, shiny black bead eyes and long, thin grey-green legs with big feet, and they wobble when they walk.
cast.portrait: Background: a grassy tussock on the bog.

places.name: the Bog Path
places.look: A narrow, winding footpath of trodden earth and pine roots running along the edge of a light forest of tall pines, spruces and silver-barked birches, where it meets a wide, open bog: soft green and rusty-red moss, tufts of white cotton grass, low heather, cloudberry leaves, grassy tussocks and small pools of dark water reflecting the sky, with low blue hills far away.

cover.prompt: Low, close view at the edge of the bog: the Dunlin, tiny and proud, stands on a mossy tussock among white cotton grass, her chest puffed out and her head held high, looking very sure of herself. Behind her, further along the Bog Path, the Hunter strolls through the sunny forest with his walking stick, smiling to himself. Warm midday light and two blue dragonflies.
cover.caption: Myrsnipen er sikker på at barna hennes er de vakreste i hele skogen.
cover.alt: En liten myrsnipe står stolt på en mosetue mellom hvit myrull. Lenger bak går en snill jeger med stokk langs stien i skogkanten.

illustrations.anchor: Midt på stien sto Myrsnipen og bredte ut vingene.
illustrations.prompt: On the Bog Path, seen from low down at bird height: right in the middle of the path stands the Dunlin, tiny beside his boots, with both wings spread wide and her beak open, pleading. The Hunter, who was strolling along with his walking stick, stops mid-step with one boot still raised and bends forward in surprise, eyebrows high, one hand holding his hat. Pines and birches on one side, the open bog with cotton grass on the other. Bright midday sun.
illustrations.caption: Midt på stien sto Myrsnipen og bredte ut vingene.
illustrations.alt: En liten myrsnipe står midt på stien med vingene bredt ut. Jegeren stopper midt i et skritt og bøyer seg overrasket fram.

illustrations.prompt: Close view beside a grassy tussock a little further along the Bog Path: the Hunter kneels in the grass and very carefully lifts the Chicks, all four of them, in his big cupped hands, looking down at them with a soft, pitying face. The four chicks huddle together in his palms, their scruffy down sticking out every which way, beaks open, peeping. White cotton grass nods around him in the sunshine.
illustrations.caption: «Stakkars dere», sier jegeren og løfter ungene forsiktig opp.
illustrations.alt: Jegeren sitter på kne i gresset og holder fire små, rufsete fugleunger i de store hendene sine. Ungene piper, og dunet stritter til alle kanter.

illustrations.anchor: Jegeren satte myrsnipungene forsiktig ned i gresset igjen.
illustrations.prompt: Beside the grassy tussock on the Bog Path, the Hunter kneels with his hat pushed back and a sheepish, gentle smile, his big hands still open where he has just set the Chicks down in the grass. The Dunlin stands proudly over them with her wings spread like a little tent, and all four fluffy chicks peek out from underneath, snug and happy. Warm, soft afternoon light.
illustrations.caption: Der inne lå de vakreste barna i hele skogen.
illustrations.alt: Jegeren sitter på kne og smiler flaut. Foran ham står Myrsnipen med vingene bredt ut over de fire rufsete ungene sine, som titter fram under vingene.
